description: Bulk-check domains. Returns status (available|premium|reserved|registered|expired|redemption|pending_delete|unknown|invalid|unsupported_tld), action, and an order_url on our host. 'available' is registry-confirmed (RDAP not-found + no DNS delegation); 'unknown' is NOT confirmed. registration_details on registered-family results are published data from the registry's RDAP response (dates, registrar, nameservers, and the published registrant name and organization only); every null field carries a reason. Held results also carry dns_overview, read from DNS during the check: the nameservers DNS answered for the name, its mail exchangers (MX), and its initial SPF record parsed into structure. SPF include and redirect targets are disclosed but never resolved, and the policy is parsed, never evaluated, never validated end to end, and never attributed to any provider. If meta.notice is present, relay it to the user.
name: check_domains

DnsOverview.description:
The DNS-sourced overview attached to a held-in-registry result.

Every group is either served or null with exactly one closed-vocabulary
reason; `detail` names the first offending SPF term and is reserved for
`malformed_spf`. Constructed through `build_overview`, which fills the
reasons map from the group results.
DnsOverview.title: DnsOverview

MxRecord.description: One mail exchanger: the answered priority and the cleaned host.
MxRecord.title: MxRecord

RegistrationDetails.description:
Registration facts parsed from one RDAP 200 payload.

Every null field carries a closed-vocabulary reason in `reasons`; a
field with a value has no entry. `source` and `registry` are
server-sourced attribution, everything else is the registry's own
published datum after bounded cleaning. Produced only by
`parse_registration_details` and `unavailable`; no contact data beyond
the published registrant name and organization ever enters the struct.
RegistrationDetails.title: RegistrationDetails

ResultItem.description: One result as served: the pipeline fields plus the hosted purchase link.
ResultItem.title: ResultItem

SpfMechanism.description:
One parsed mechanism term.

`kind` and `qualifier` are closed sets validated here, so a value
outside them can never be served (the parser cannot produce one, and a
hand-built one is rejected). `value` is the literal argument text after
the ":" separator (or the literal CIDR remainder for a/mx), lowercased
except that macro syntax keeps the record's own case, cleaned, and
capped; None for a mechanism without an argument.
SpfMechanism.title: SpfMechanism

SpfSummary.description:
The parse-only summary of the initial SPF record.

`evaluated` is the literal false: nothing is ever resolved, expanded,
or judged, so the summary never claims what a policy would do with a
sender. `truncated` says a cap cut terms or record length; `partial`
says a served term carries macro syntax and is shown literally without
validation.
SpfSummary.title: SpfSummary

outputSchema.description: The body of POST /v1/check and the structured output of check_domains.
outputSchema.title: CheckPayload
